title: StoryRequest
description: Document story_requests/story_{session_id} (SDD 8, 11): the Reading Coach's queue_story request. Producer of the request fields: Reading Coach (W3), written before it publishes plan.ready. Consumer: Passage Generator (W2), which handles plan.ready, generates the child's next passage with no deadline and no bank fallback, then adds status, passage_id and processed_at and sets children/{child_id}.next_passage_id. Idempotent: a request that already has a passage_id is skipped.
